title: AVID POWER 20V Cordless Drill Set for Home DIY & Beginner Projects - Lightweight Power Drill with Battery Charger & 22 Bits, Variable Speed, 3/8" Keyless Chuck, Ideal for Furniture Assembly (Blue)
features: Long-Lasting Battery for Occasional Users - AVID POWER 20V Lithium-ion battery pack comes with a real-time battery level display, which allows you to monitor charge status, so you're never caught off guard during projects. Perfect for homeowners who use a drill a few times a month. This drill can only use the battery from AVID POWER, please do not use a battery from other brand or a battery with a larger capacity

Note: Regardless of whether you use it immediately, please fully charge the battery after receiving the product. When the machine is out of use, remove the battery from the drill and recharge it every 3 months for longer life

15+1 Torque Settings for Delicate Work - 15+1 torque (280 In-lbs) settings and variable speed (0-550 RPM) provide precise control for driving in/out screws to prevent stripping, and drilling into wood, drywall, plastics, and even metal with ease. Max torque for drilling into wood 13/16-Inch or steel plate 3/8-Inch. Note: this drill is Not suitable for more than 25mm drill bits and Not for Concrete/Masonry Walls

Ergonomic & Lightweight Design: Compact, 2.5 lb lightweight build with a rubberized grip reduces fatigue during prolonged use, making it easy to handle even for first-time users. Built-in LED light illuminates dark workspaces like cabinets and tight corners for precise operation, while the 3/8” keyless chuck enables quick, tool-free bit changes to boost your home project efficiency

Complete Ready-to-Use Kit - Includes 22 practical accessories: 10 drill bits, 10 driver bits, flexible shaft, and extension bar. Perfect for first-time owners tackling furniture assembly, wall mounting, or tight-space tasks

Perfect for DIY & Gift-Giving：Versatile for home repairs, furniture assembly, and crafts. Packaged in a box, it’s an ideal choice for holidays, birthdays, or empowering beginners and homeowners with reliable performance
